init_distributed: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group using NCCL backend with SLURM or manual rank and world size
AllGather_forward: gather tensors from all processes and concatenate them along dimension 0 with gradient support
AllGather_backward: compute gradients for AllGather by all-reducing and slicing per-rank gradient segments
AllReduceSum: perform an in-place all-reduce sum across all processes with passthrough backward gradients
AllReduce: perform a normalized all-reduce average across all processes by dividing by world size before reducing
